environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. JWT_SIGNING_SECRET is set via AWS Secrets Manager with manual rotation (last rotated 90 days ago). Service mesh uses plain HTTP between internal services. No OPA sidecar or authorization middleware. ALB forwards all authenticated traffic to the service without path-based filtering.

config.network: ALB -> ECS, no service mesh authz
